claims.requirement: Concurrent transactions competing for the same town resolution or the same item's custody resolve to exactly one winner under real CockroachDB serialization, never a duplicate or lost effect.

primary.test: lets only one town resolution exist, whichever writer arrives first

claims.isolationReason: Proves at-most-one-writer-wins outcomes under real concurrent transactions; a shared fixture's resets from neighboring files would confound the timing this test depends on (VPR-06).

claims.requirement: A real CockroachDB SERIALIZABLE conflict is retried transparently and re-runs the whole transaction body; retries stop at the configured deadline instead of retrying forever.

primary.test: retries a real serialization conflict and re-runs the body whole

claims.isolationReason: Proves the transaction helper's serialization/retry behavior against real engine contention; a shared fixture's concurrent resets would confound the timing this suite depends on (VPR-06).

claims.requirement: The prompt evaluation corpus covers every prompt family with at least a control and a known-failure/boundary fixture, and a run that regresses a previously-passing fixture against the committed baseline is caught.

primary.test: checkCorpusShape passes when every family has a control and a known-failure/boundary fixture

claims.requirement: The model-runtime package's tests stay inside the vitest project list, so `pnpm test` and `pnpm validate` cannot silently stop collecting them.

primary.test: model-runtime remains a member of the full vitest project list

claims.source: VPR audit — vitest project membership drift

claims.requirement: An allocated join secret reaches no player-visible surface: not the DOM, not an error surface, not the console, and not the browser's address bar, storage, or cookies.

primary.test: never exposes a live join secret to the DOM, an error surface, or the console

secondary.test: shows the tokenless /join in the address bar, and the token never leaks into storage, cookies, the console, or the DOM
secondary.uniqueProof: Checks the real address bar, cookies, and browser storage — surfaces a component test cannot observe at all — in addition to re-confirming DOM/console cleanliness inside an actual browser session.

claims.requirement: The foundation CDK stack's synthesized IAM policies never grant a wildcard action or resource, and no synthesized template contains a plaintext secret value.

primary.test: grants no wildcard action or resource

claims.requirement: A player can create a town, join, resume the same identity, travel, inspect, safely reload mid-journey, retry one action idempotently, and leave — all across the real HTTP, database, and browser-session boundary.

primary.test: the first playable journey: create, join, resume, travel, inspect, replay, leave, away, return

claims.isolationReason: Full page reloads and session-cookie persistence across a multi-step journey require a real browser session against the real backend; no lower boundary can observe reload/cookie persistence together with committed server state (Phase 3 exit gate).

claims.requirement: A claim confirmed by one player, grounded in CockroachDB memory, demonstrably shapes a later dialogue for a second player, and an unconfirmed false claim leaves its object's belief untouched — across two persisted browser sessions.

primary.test: grounded memory: Player A's confirmed claim shapes Player B's dialogue and evidence changes belief, with the object of a false claim left untouched

claims.isolationReason: Requires two concurrently persisted real browser sessions (Player A and Player B) reloading against committed server-side memory; a component or API-level test cannot observe cross-player, cross-session dialogue effects (Phase 4/5 joint exit gate).
